rationale: The base proposal's concentrated limiter was a speculative general pool with no wedge against scaled full-stack incumbents and no proven density or acquisition path. The redesign implements the evaluator's highest-value structural change without claiming it has occurred: it narrows the customer to one anchor network and one closed-loop lane, makes a minimum-volume buyer contract plus courier and service approvals a precondition to asset exposure, uses a dedicated or customer-segmented pool, prefers leasing where actually available, and bundles reporting into the turn charge. This changes the customer, paid event, offer, distribution mechanism, compounding mechanism, control point, critical dependency, and structured economics. All commitments, rights, supplier terms, prices, costs, utilization, margins, payback, and conversion remain explicitly unobserved or hypothetical.
